translations.1: In the morning, the mist outside the mountain gate has not dissipated.
translations.10: Ms. Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the ward, we and Mr. Wan sit here.
translations.11: Okay. Ms. You, wake up, and immediately call me.
translations.12: Wan Yi Jing scratched his head and then turned to run towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: 解玄站在殿门口，剑还未拔出，但灯光却突然变暗。
translations.14: Elder Qin, how are you? I came on behalf of the Master to collect one-third of the spirit stones.
translations.15: Three-fifths? The spirit stones are the sect's hard-earned savings, when is it their turn to take them?
translations.16: The ward is already broken, the spirit stones are not safe in your hands. I will come back in three days.
translations.17: 解玄冷笑一声，转身便走，头也不回。
translations.18: He said three days is three days, and he never breaks his promise.
translations.19: 覃长老捋着胡须，望了望榻上昏睡的仇霜。
translations.2: Yunzhou, you have finally returned. Have you brought enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, please let me guard the ward. The lady, @仇霜, is being taken care of by @乐川, so I can leave.
translations.21: Finally, he nodded and took out a jade token.
translations.22: This is the key to the center. By guarding it, you will guard your path.
translations.23: 乐川把药袋塞进云舟怀里，又低声叮嘱了几句。
translations.24: At the entrance to the mountain, Wanqi Jing delivered a蓑衣 (蓑衣 -蓑衣).
translations.25: Thank you, Wanqi Senior Brother. Tell @仇姑娘 (仇姑娘 -仇姑娘) to thank me.
translations.26: Shàn Yúnzhōu nodded, and put the ward-keeping order close to his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Ms. @仇霜 slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: It's good that you're awake. You've been unconscious for a whole day, so please don't move around randomly.
translations.29: 仇霜 struggled to sit up and looked at the torn sky outside the window.
translations.3: I brought three bags, all from the best part of the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed, the letter in his pocket was sealed with 解玄's seal.
translations.4: The ward has cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep.

translations.8: Wan Yi Que Jing backed into the main hall, carrying the unconscious woman, with a metal badge on his waist engraved with: Qiushuang.
